annotations.title: Submit a request for the visitor

description: Send a request to Rayon Insurance on the visitor's behalf: a contract review, quotes for a company running robots, a broker placement, an integrator checklist, a marketplace seller requirement, or Rayon Ops servicing. It files the same request as the form on the site and a person replies by email within two business days. It does not bind cover or produce a quote. Only call it after the visitor has seen what will be sent and asked you to send it. Documents cannot be attached here; the reply says where to email them.

company.description: The company's legal name. Required for contract_review.

email.description: The visitor's work email. The reply goes here.

kind.description: operators: A company running robots wants its insurance and robot contracts reviewed, with quotes for any gap. brokers: A retail broker wants a placement partner for a client deploying robots. integrators: A robotics integrator wants the customer-side insurance checklist for its SOW. sellers: A marketplace seller needs to meet a seller agreement's insurance requirement. contract_review: Send a contract (RaaS agreement, SOW, site-access agreement) to be read against the company's insurance. agency_servicing: A commercial insurance brokerage wants help with servicing work (Rayon Ops).

message.description: What the visitor needs, in their words: the contract, robots, site, deadline or question.

visitor_confirmed.description: Must be true. Set it only after the visitor has seen what will be sent, agreed to be contacted by Rayon Insurance and to its privacy notice (https://rayoninsure.com/privacy), and asked you to send it.
